output.rationale: The requirement specifies a metal-clad switchgear capable of handling a low-frequency test voltage of 36 kV. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is described as arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear with a voltage class up to 38 kV, which matches the requirement. This product is offered as engineered-to-order (ETO), suitable for the specific technical needs of the Syracuse Airport Specification.
